Register font 'STIX Two Math'

Source: R/stix.R
register_stixmath.Rd

Register the font 'STIX Two Math', shipped with 'gdtools', so that it can be found by name with the 'systemfonts' package: by functions measuring or drawing equations (such as the 'equatags' package) and by graphic devices using 'systemfonts' ('ragg', 'svglite', 'ggiraph').

'STIX Two Math' is an OpenType math font: it has a 'MATH' table giving the parameters used to lay out equations, and size variants of operators and delimiters.

Nothing is done when a font is already found under name, for example when 'STIX Two Math' is installed on the system (it is on macOS).

Usage

register_stixmath(name = "STIX Two Math")

Arguments

name

the name to use for the font family when registering with 'systemfonts'.

Value

TRUE if a font is found under name after the operation.

License
